acceptance.note: A/B/A diagnostic gate only. Both180/210 require>=5% CPU gain against faster A;60 CPU and all wall/tails allow at most5% regression;>10% A drift is inconclusive. Every arm requires>=1440 active ticks and<=160 terminal ticks per count. Tails are eight200-tick episode windows, not frame percentiles. This does not replace the unchanged original24000-tick/15000ms CPU test.

note: Same-process fixed A1/B/A2, fresh normal Game episode per window. Fixture/setup and snapshot/full literal state+RNG+events+command/navigation proof/hash/compare are outside timers. The original event-drain arrays and already-created commands are retained in preallocated200-entry arrays during time, without clone/hash/comparison or added method hooks. Equal work is required; active and terminal/no-op ticks are disclosed. These short normal-HP episodes are neither the twenty-minute stress test nor the whole product loop/HUD/audio/persistence/GPU/FPS/heap/peakRAM. External --cpu-prof is diagnostic only, and its startup/setup/warmup/proof samples must be separated from tick attribution.
proofSemantics: Full serialized finite-state/commands/events/both RNG/navigation equality against A1, outside timers. JSON serialization normalizes negative zero; this is not universal IEEE64 Game equality. Independent damping unit tests cover IEEE64 arithmetic.
